detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A Souls-inspired action RPG set in a sandbox open world with an MMO feel and challenging directional combat. Play solo or with up to 3 friends in co-op. Build friendships, master an unrestricted class system, and uncover the cause that darkened all eyes.

Story

The story is not told in a linear fashion. Instead, you experience it naturally as you explore the world, interact with factions, and discover their secrets.

The main plot revolves around an event that darkened everyone's eyes. This event had two far-reaching consequences: it gave all living beings a cursed immortality and resurrected the dead as soulless beings.

As a result, the world fragmented into factions, each with its own ideology on how to deal with this new reality.

Some seek to restore the natural order at any cost. Others believe this state of affairs is a form of evolution or a blessing, but now struggle to control the relentless threat posed by the soulless. Still others seek a way to coexist with or even control the soulless, viewing them as a resource rather than an abomination.

Key Features

  • Character Customization: Use a character editor to customize your avatar's appearance to your liking.

  • Unrestricted Class Sytem: Craft a deep, fully customizable class using a wide variety of weapons, armor, abilities, and talents tailored to your playstyle. A stealthy rogue wielding a great axe and hurling fireballs, anything is possible.

  • Direction-based Combat: Engage in intense, challenging, and fluid directional combat scenarios.

  • Story: The story is not told in a linear fashion. Instead, you experience it naturally as you explore the world, interact with factions, and discover their secrets.

  • MMO Feel: Discover a lively world with MMO feel, where you can meet and interact with other players.

  • Singleplayer: Play solo with up to three companions or in co-op mode with up to four players. Build friendships with your companions, customize their equipment and skills, and tailor their playstyle to suit your strategy.

  • Multiplayer: Easily participate in co-op quests for up to four players or competitive PvP battles (1v1 and 2v2). The matchmaking feature lets you jump right into the action.

  • Shape the Open-World Sandbox: Shape the world through your actions by intercepting caravans to weaken villages, exploiting conflicts between rival factions, and conquering villages and cities to take control and collect taxes.

  • Procedural Encounters: Discover varied, procedurally generated encounters full of secrets, unique items, allies, and challenges. Find your own way to overcome obstacles by creatively using the skills you've acquired.

  • Retro meets modern gaming: Step into a unique pixel-art retro fantasy environment with 2D HD textures in modern and never-before-seen graphics full of surprises, twisted monsters and deadly bosses.
